description: The tests of one or more .NET test projects or solutions, each in a job of its own: dotnet build and then dotnet test, with the .NET SDK version the project names; a job fails when no test ran. Invented example: {"projects": [{"sdk-version": "10.0.x", "project": "tests/Shop.Tests/Shop.Tests.csproj"}], "paths": ["src/", "tests/"]}.

projects.description: The test projects or solutions that are built and tested, one job per item; the smallest form is one item that names its sdk-version and its project.

sdk-version.description: The .NET SDK version that actions/setup-dotnet installs.

project.description: The test project or the solution that is built and tested, as a path relative to the repository root.

runner-label.description: The label of the GitHub-hosted runner of the item's job. Without it, ubuntu-26.04.
